decisions.statement: The manifests are picked out of the paths handed in.
A path with the file name the `workspace-manifest` property states is a manifest.
A caller with no paths reads the manifests off the pages with a manifest property.
The manifests are read from every property whose file has that file name.
A manifest is beside the page with that manifest.
The name that property states is asked of the index.
An index stating no such property is answered as reaching nothing.
The folder a manifest names against is the folder the manifest stands in.
A body is read through the reader the caller hands in rather than off the disk here.
A manifest whose body does not stand is passed over.
A rebuild is answered from the files its pages state.
A settle is answered from the manifests the index names and the paths the change has.
A settle reads no path the change leaves alone.
A manifest the change has is read as the change leaves the manifest.
Where a specifier landed before a change is read from the manifests as those manifests were.
A manifest moving where a specifier lands answers with every importer of that specifier.
An importer is read from beside the page imported rather than sought in the tree.
An importer the change already has is left out of that answer.
A specifier a manifest reaches anew answers with the importers that already name the specifier.
No specifier is resolved through `node_modules`.
Nothing here writes.

definition: where each specifier naming a package lands, read from the manifests standing
